items.label: Briefing Note
items.description:
EYES ONLY — DESTROY AFTER READING

Target: SOVA-7 cipher device, Soviet mountain outpost, grid ref withheld.
Objective: Photograph rotor configuration before cipher officer returns from dinner.
Extraction: Black Volga, mountain road. Driver will wait.
Deadline: Dinner ends. Do not miss the car.

Good luck. You'll need it.

items.label: Wire Cutters
items.description: Heavy-duty cutters. Enough to open a gap in chain-link. Not consumed on use.

items.label: Service Keycard
items.description: A Soviet military-issue keycard. Stencilled with a facility code.

items.label: Camera
items.description: A 35mm miniature camera. The film is loaded.

evelyn.text: You raise the camera. Evelyn doesn't look up from her file. 'I saw that, Mr. Kesher.' She turns a page. 'The machine is in a mountain, not in Whitehall. I suggest you save the film.' You put it away.

items.label: Cipher Room Key
items.description: A small brass key stamped with a cipher wheel emblem. Opens the cipher room.

items.label: Cipher Room Key
items.description: A duplicate brass key, stamped with a cipher wheel emblem. Opens the cipher room.

items.label: Duty Office Key
items.description: A small key, slightly bent. Someone was in a hurry when they left it behind.

items.label: Maintenance Key
items.description: A chunky key on a wire loop. Maintenance issue.

items.label: Flashbang
items.description: A compact stun grenade, Soviet-issue. One use. Throws a guard off long enough to get past him.

items.label: Pipe Wrench
items.description: A heavy adjustable wrench, slick with grease. Not elegant, but effective.

items.label: Mosin-Nagant
items.description: A bolt-action rifle. Heavy, accurate, and loud enough to wake the mountain.

items.label: Makarov Pistol
items.description: Standard Soviet sidearm. Eight rounds, reliable, and considerably quieter than a rifle.

items.label: Soviet Uniform
items.description: Standard-issue drab green, rank insignia for a private. Wearing it you might pass a cursory inspection — provided you keep moving and don't let anyone look too closely.
